title: Kissed Golden Mushroom Pilaf
description: A flavorful pilaf dish made with kissed golden mushrooms and dutch pilaf, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Kissed golden mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Use fresh mushrooms and kiss them with butter or olive oil for extra flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the kissed golden mushrooms and cook until they're tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic powder and dried thyme to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the Dutch pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf is heated through.
